rules.infinite_in_degree: X_1(4,12) has only finitely many points of degree 6
rules.sporadic: finitely many points of each degree <= 6 on X_1(4,12)
rules.isolated: finitely many points of degree 6 on X_1(4,12), so the point lies in no positive-dimensional family

points.reference: E. González-Jiménez, F. Najman, An algorithm for determining torsion growth of elliptic curves, Exp. Math. 32 (2023), no. 1, 70-81, arXiv:1904.07071; the result is stated in Remark 1 of H. B. Daniels, E. González-Jiménez, Serre's constant of elliptic curves over the rationals, arXiv:1808.02887 (2018). The curve is 162d1 over K = Q(alpha, i), alpha^3 - 3 alpha - 4 = 0.
